summary:
EXISTS: the in_progress liveness-repair reaper is fully built in daemon.js — sweepStaleClaims() (L192) reverts dead-agent in_progress→ready via releaseClaim() (L178, clears overlay override + native status→'pending', idempotent), gated on agent.state!=running AND overlay.timestamps.lastChanged past stale_minutes (default 10). Wired into decideAll()/buildGraph (L411,627) + restart demotion (L82). sweepStaleLoops() handles zombie loops. Escalation gate (request_guidance/pendingGuidance) exists but fires ONLY on agent-raised calls + the 5 ESCALATION_DEFAULTS triggers.

GAP: the SURFACING half is missing — nothing auto-detects a stale tested/ready task and enqueues guidance. No sweep reads st==='tested'/'ready' + age. Insertion point: a new sweepStaleVerdicts() mirroring sweepStaleClaims, enqueuing overlayStore.pendingGuidance instead of mutating status, called in decideAll(). Fields ready: overlay.status, timestamps.lastChanged, assignee, agents[].state.

RECOMMENDATION: task #2 (in_progress reaper) is DONE — cancel/narrow to a verification check. Task #3 (surface stale tested/ready) is still needed as-scoped — that's the only real remaining work.
